script:
setclipboard("https://discord.gg/TR3quUFgT6")

local runservice = game:GetService("RunService")

runservice.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	local runservice = game:GetService("RunService")
	local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

	local clickremote = rs:WaitForChild("ClickRemote")
	local updatebaseclick = rs:WaitForChild("UpdateBaseClick")

	local args = {999999}

	runservice.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		clickremote:FireServer(args[1])
		updatebaseclick:FireServer(args[1])
	end)
end)
